title: PERCEIVED FAIRNESS AND THE MACHINE LEARNING DEVELOPMENT PROCESS: CONCEPT SCALE DEVELOPMENT
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion.
findings: No findings related to religion were presented in the paper. The paper focuses on developing a concept scale for perceived fairness in the machine learning development process, drawing on justice theory and focus groups with developers.
